entries.what: Slept in until 9, then drove the 9 minutes down Ruel Road to RF-4 for the 2 p.m. swing. Gas fill-up at the Ruel Road station on the way.
entries.outcome: Arrived on time and cleared the morning ticket queue.

entries.what: Greg forwarded the annual self-review form and Rhonda's office assigned it, due Sept 30. Noemi skimmed it in the IT cage next to the outbound break room.
entries.outcome: Review is on the calendar; she put off starting it.

entries.what: Worked through a pile of frozen handhelds in the cage and updated the RMA sheet for scanners headed back to the vendor.
entries.outcome: Eleven scanners logged for return.

entries.what: Got home after 10:30, ate a leftover rice bowl with Iris and watched a show on the shared streaming account.
entries.outcome: Went to bed around 1 a.m.

entries.what: Slow morning, then a few chapters of the tabbed study guide and practice-test app before work.
entries.outcome: Missed subnetting questions again.

entries.what: From 3 to 5 p.m. she trained Bao on scanner battery swaps and trigger boards in the cage.
entries.outcome: Bao did a battery swap alone without help.

entries.what: Carla texted Noemi's cell about three dead scanners on the outbound floor; Noemi walked out with replacements.
entries.outcome: Pickers were back on rate within 15 minutes.

entries.what: Fixed her parents' printer remotely on a late break call.
entries.outcome: Printer works again.

entries.what: Grabbed a large iced black coffee and drove to RF-4 for the swing shift.
entries.outcome: Day started normally.

entries.what: During a lull she designed a phishing-awareness poster for the outbound break room after a spam email hit the night crew.
entries.outcome: Draft poster ready to print.

entries.what: After work she logged into her co-op survival game as packetloss_ using her usual password, same as everything personal.
entries.outcome: Played until about 12:30 with her Sunday squad.

entries.what: Slept in, then went through practice questions at the kitchen counter while Iris left for work.
entries.outcome: Completed one full practice exam.

entries.what: Ran the Thursday 3-5 p.m. training block with Bao, covering scanner trigger boards.
entries.outcome: Bao is getting faster.

entries.what: Iris ordered sushi for Thursday night; they ate it late after Noemi got home.
entries.outcome: Easy evening.

entries.what: Booked the network certification exam online for Saturday Nov 8 at 9 a.m. at the Tamsen city testing center, after her latest practice test averaged 71%.
entries.outcome: Exam is booked and the pass line is around 75%.

entries.what: Went to work for the swing shift and brought Taquería Colima for Friday lunch.
entries.outcome: Ate in the IT cage while working tickets.

entries.what: Told Iris about the exam booking that night and Iris offered to help plan around it.
entries.outcome: Agreed to figure out a study plan tomorrow.

entries.what: Walked the Ulloa marsh boardwalk Saturday morning, then asked for a 12-week study plan for the Nov 8 exam the day after booking it.
entries.outcome: Got a week-by-week plan to work from.

entries.what: Heard the Ridgeline peak-season hiring fair was packed with college students; saw the line while doing a weekend scanner check at RF-4.
entries.outcome: Helped Ana's table with a badge reader that wouldn't boot.

entries.what: Gamed with the Sunday squad a day early and made dinner with Iris.
entries.outcome: Quiet night in.

entries.what: Slept late, then sat down with Iris's household budget sheet to figure out how to enter the $238-ish car repair for the check-engine light.
entries.outcome: Asked how to split the repair cost in Iris's budget sheet; Iris set up a line.

entries.what: Stopped by her parents' fourplex off Vinca for a late lunch and fixed her mom's phone.
entries.outcome: Left with leftovers.

entries.what: Sunday night co-op game session with her squad.
entries.outcome: Won the run and went to bed around 1.
